HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Scriptures and Moral values? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Scriptures and Moral values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Scriptures and Moral values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Scriptures and Moral values has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Scriptures and Moral values.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Communal aspects of Yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Say Communal aspects of Yoga has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Communal aspects of Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Communal aspects of Yoga to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Communal aspects of Yoga.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Utsav from other faiths? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Utsav from other faiths with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Utsav from other faiths has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Utsav from other faiths.
   D. Use Utsav from other faiths to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

6. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism.
   D. Say Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism? (1 mark)
   A. Use Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism.
   D. Say Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism has no place in daily life.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues .
